title: The rifles as you picked them: the R-7, its finishes, and the designs kept
about: Your scores of 2026-11-08 applied. The R-7 is G2 in the Corps' black with V1's sight ("I would prefer this gun with the scope of the V1, for short and mid range engagements"): G2's skeleton stock, receivers, slotted handguard, angled foregrip, light and brake, with V1's carry handle, its rail and the boxed red dot. A red dot alone is 1×, and the SO-4 has always had its 4× lever, so the SO-4 is drawn as the dot with a 4× flip magnifier behind it (my call, to score): in line with the box when you believe the lever at 4×, swung down beside its mount at 1×; at 300 m its turrets sit on the box. No card draws the green arch any more ("get rid of the green arch it serves no purpose"). The finishes ("multiple colors so we can equip ourselves to camo in environments depending on deployments"): the Corps' black (the issue's), flat dark earth, Mars rust (the regolith's own red dust), Earth desert, Europa ice, Earth woodland and urban grey, one per squad, any design in any of them. G1 is kept as an alternate, V1 kept (here in black), M1 is the R-7M's drawing, G0 is gone. The magazine is 9 px wide, as you scored it with G2 (7 px since your "bit slicker" of 2026-11-07). Each view is drawn by the game's code: a is the weapon card in three beliefs (on the line at 1×, at 300 m at 4×, a stovepipe with a magazine in the hand), b the chibi at 16 px/m in five poses and four facings on the bay's floor and the regolith, the rifle alone and the doll; the figures snapped to the Mars palette as the stage snaps them, the card and the doll raw as in the game.

groups.title: R7: the R-7 as the game now draws it (G2's body, V1's sight, the SO-4's flip magnifier), the Corps' black
groups.about: The standard issue as you picked it, in the issue's black. On the card, left, the lever believed at 1×: the magnifier swung down beside its mount behind the box; middle, at 4×: the magnifier in line, its glass at both ends, the turrets on the box (the elevation's on its hood, the windage's at its front). On the figure the box and its glint on the carry handle's hump over G2's body.

groups.title: R7F: the R-7 in every finish
groups.about: One sheet of the seven finishes, each the card on the line and the chibi aimed and prone on the bay's floor and on the regolith. Mars rust's base is the regolith's own colour; Europa ice's metal is a mid grey so nothing on it is black against snow; urban grey is the steel greys' middle steps. The figures' stock and sight stay gun metal at 16 px/m (a finish there colours the furniture).
